Questions sellers ask

Straight answers — no small print.

Is it really free to try?

Yes. Your first session is completely free and fully functional — add up to 3 products, see your true profit and get your full diagnosis. No card, no signup.

How does Pro pricing work?

Pro is $3.99/month or $19.99/year (two months free). You pay once per period — there is no automatic charge. To cancel, simply don’t renew.

How do I pay, and how fast do I get Pro?

Right here on the site: PayPal, Visa/Mastercard (via PayPal — no PayPal account needed) or crypto (BTC, USDT, ETH & 100+). Pro activates in your browser the second your payment completes — no codes to paste, nothing to wait for.

Is my data safe?

Your products and numbers are stored only in your own browser — never on our servers. There is no account to hack and nothing to leak.

What exactly do I get with Pro?

Unlimited products, the What-If Simulator (test any change safely), cost ranking, profit goal planner, advanced recommendations, PDF report export and CSV import/export — plus priority support.
